name: Robertson
terms: Wine of Origin, region, district, ward, estate

South Africa's appellation system since 1973, nested from regions down to districts and wards. A ward is roughly a European appellation. An estate wine may come from neighboring farms farmed and made together.
A red blend with 30 to 70% Pinotage, set by the industry rather than by law. Since the 2019 vintage Pinotage should be its largest part.

notes: Robertson has lime-rich soils. Summers can be hot, but cooling southeasterly winds bring moist air into the valley.
Long seen as white wine country, it is known for Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.
It also makes Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and the fortified dessert wines it was first known for.

blurb.text: A district in the Breede River Valley, in the Western Cape, containing McGregor, Bonnievale, Le Chasseur and others. Plantings are spread across Colombard (14%), Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay (13% each) and Chenin Blanc.
